items.back: Central Sector = 100% Union-funded (PM-KISAN); CSS = shared Centre-State (60:40, 90:10 special), largely State-List subjects (MGNREGA, PMAY, JJM).
DBT sends benefits straight to bank accounts; rides on JAM trinity = Jan Dhan + Aadhaar + Mobile; cuts leakage.
PM-KISAN = ₹6,000/yr in 3 instalments to landholding farmers. Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY = ₹5 lakh/family health cover; extended to all 70+ (2024).
MGNREGA 2005 = 100 days guaranteed wage employment + statutory social audit. PMUY = free LPG connections to poor women.
Farmer premium: 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial/horticultural crops (2016; Ministry of Agriculture).
PMJJBY = life cover ₹2 lakh; PMSBY = accident cover ₹2 lakh; Atal Pension Yojana = guaranteed old-age pension.
items.examPoint: Social-security insurance trio — PMJJBY, PMSBY, Atal Pension Yojana

items.back: Mission Indradhanush = immunisation; SWAYAM = online MOOCs; DDU-GKY = rural youth skilling; PMJDY = financial inclusion (RuPay, ₹2 lakh cover).
Funds create durable assets; district authority inspects a share; unused funds are carried forward (do NOT lapse); SC/ST earmark.
items.examPoint: MPLADS — durable assets; unused funds carried forward
